estimatedFields: the tilt times and the door opening as drawn (the report has the doors open at 204:06:08:35, MET 1:37:35; the scene compresses that wait; the press kit plans the 29 deg tilt at MET 5:35)

upperStage stage1.met and stage2.met (Jonathan McDowell's STS-93 page, to the minute: SRM-1 at 12:48 UTC, SRM-2 at 12:51 UTC) and their burn lengths (the press kit's planned 125 s and 117 s; the report says about two minutes each)
springMs and tableLowerDeg (the STS-30 and STS-34 press kits' tilt-table figures; the STS-93 kit gives none)
the first separation burn drawn as one 6.7 s burn (the report: two RCS pulses of 0.54 s and 6.7 s)

provenance.l: NASA STS-93 Mission Report: launch 204:04:30:59.984 GMT; orbit after OMS-2 144.7 x 153.7 nmi; payload bay doors open 204:06:08:35; Chandra/IUS deployed 204:11:47:01 (MET 7:16:01); -X separation 204:11:48:25 with RCS F2F and F3F pulses of 0.54 s and 6.7 s; OMS-3 204:12:02:25.3 to 12:02:59.7, 34.5 ft/s; IUS first stage about two minutes, about an hour after deploy
STS-93 press kit: tilt table to 29 deg at MET 5:35 (plan), then 58 deg for deploy; IUS stage 1 125 s, stage 2 117 s
Jonathan McDowell, STS-93 and AXAF: tilt to 58 deg 11:42 UTC, deploy 11:47, IUS SRM-1 12:48 to 12:50, SRM-2 12:51 to 12:53 UTC
